FormaView 0.2.0 for Windows x64 includes locally built libmpv and FFmpeg.
The replaceable DLLs are located beside formaview.exe.

mpv f92afa75cdb06e077a9ecd9a9ec2eb36b16327c2 was configured with GPL features
disabled. Its embedded FFmpeg is 64f6bcffaf2646d76463c89f13a8ae9abe0a1b66.
The five separate FFmpeg shared libraries use
f1acb0a2666c78d92688f4c3d2803a132f5590f6 and report LGPL version 3 or later.
See mpv-Copyright.txt, libmpv-LICENSE.txt, ffmpeg-LICENSE.txt,
media-runtime-GPLv3.txt and both FFmpeg license notes for the terms.
Modification and reverse engineering for debugging modifications to the LGPL
libraries are permitted under the applicable license. No warranty is provided.

The companion FormaView-0.2.0-media-sources.zip contains source trees, patches,
build scripts, dependency source mappings and notices. See SOURCE-KIT.txt inside.
media-builds.json identifies the DLLs and the exact cross-build environment.
media-static-copyrights.txt reproduces upstream notices and includes attribution
for sources and build inputs as well as libraries linked into the binaries.

LuaJIT 63c8f1a9b479ba5518cf6a170ff7729178bc3cfd. The build removes the
Libs.private line in etc/luajit.pc. See LuaJIT.applied.patch in the source kit.
libsixel 72ed7d6b4a2252a6245567908c32c4e8e8c226ea and libarchive
432ab464725aa99c53de7572979bd9bbbf382ed1 were built from the locked trees.
See the original LuaJIT COPYRIGHT, libsixel LICENSE files, and libarchive
COPYING and individual file notices in the accompanying materials.
